text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Zzz... snore... Huh?! Ah, I fell asleep 
again...! I've never been very good with 
small print...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I did curl up at home with a book on snowy 
days sometimes, but foraging for mountain 
herbs, catching river fish, and being 
active outdoors just suited me a whole lot 
better.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I've always avoided reading, but still! I 
wanna become a stylish "City Girl" who 
reads at fancy cafes~...!
